name: Santa's Fun Fest at Grace Christian Fellowship
when_note: The main Fun Fest runs from 9 to 11 am, and a separate sensory-friendly Fun Fest runs from 1:30 to 3 pm.
paras: Grace Christian Fellowship invites Permian Basin families to Santa's Fun Fest on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 9 to 11 am at its Odessa campus. The church calls it 100 percent free and open to the public.

The morning lists a pancake breakfast, pictures with Santa, a snowball fight, a Christmas craft, hot cocoa, story time and Christmas games. A separate sensory-friendly event at 1:30 pm is set aside for families with special needs.
tip: Families with children who need a quieter setting can use the 1:30 pm sensory-friendly session instead.

name: Holiday Storytimes and Crafts at Ector County Library
when_note: Wednesday storytimes run from 10:30 to 11:30 am, and Family Night Holiday Ornaments on December 21 runs from 4:30 to 5:30 pm.
paras: Ector County Library holds winter and holiday storytimes on Wednesdays, December 2, 9 and 16, 2026, at 10:30 am. Each one reads seasonal stories in the auditorium, then moves to the basement activity room for a craft: a sequin tree ornament, a bead ornament and a reindeer windsock.

On Monday, December 21, from 4:30 to 5:30 pm, Family Night Holiday Ornaments invites the whole family to make ornaments. The library says all its events and crafts are free and first come, first served.
tip: Crafts are first come, first served, so arrive early for storytime.

name: Andrews Lighted Christmas Parade
paras: The Andrews Lighted Christmas Parade rolls on Friday, December 4, 2026, at 7 pm, and the chamber lists it as a free event. This year's theme is the Polar Express.
Andrews sits about 40 miles northwest of Odessa. The chamber's listing does not give a route, so check with the chamber before you pick a spot.
tip: Dress warmly, since West Texas evenings in December run cold.
